get.summary: Start an OAuth or OIDC login
get.description: Redirects to the provider and sets the `llmobs_oauth` cookie. `redirect` is kept when it starts with `/`, does not start with `//` or `/\`, is at most 1024 bytes, and contains no ASCII control character. Otherwise the browser returns to `/`. An unknown provider is 404. When metadata cannot be loaded, the response redirects to `/login?error=provider_unavailable` and sets no cookie.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Relative path to open after a successful login.

parameters.name: setup_token
parameters.description: First-run setup token. Stored in the login cookie and accepted only while no user exists.

302.description: Redirect to the provider, or to `/login?error=provider_unavailable`.

get.summary: Finish an OAuth or OIDC login
get.description: Clears the login cookie. Success sets the session cookie and redirects to the saved relative path. Failure redirects to `/login?error=<code>`. Codes: `invalid_state`, `provider_error`, `provider_unavailable`, `email_not_verified`, `domain_not_allowed`, `signup_closed`, `account_disabled`, `link_refused`, `setup_required`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State value from the authorization redirect.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Error code from the provider, when it refused the login.

post.description: Runs one read-only statement over the project's `spans`, `traces`, `sessions` and `scores` views (spec 05 § SQL console). `from` and `to` window `spans` and `traces` on `start_time` and `scores` on `created_at`. Without them the query reads all history. At most 10,000 rows; `truncated` says when more matched. SQL errors are `invalid_filter` on the `query` field, with a `position` when one is known. Exports stream; an error before the first row is a problem document, a later one cuts the transfer. `timeout_ms` bounds the whole export.

The first of those types in `Accept`, or `application/json`, decides; anything else is JSON.
